---
title: Read the session-start report
---

When a session starts, Sentinel checks that it can run and that your agent's settings let it run.
It reports each problem it finds as one line that starts with `Warning:` or `Error:`.
When it finds no problem, it reports nothing.
Sentinel never changes a setting: you clear each finding yourself.

## Where the report appears

The agent may display the report when the session starts, as a message from the hook or as a notification.
Note that some agents may not run the check on session start (Codex runs it when you send the first prompt).
If an agent shows only part of the report, read the full text in the agent's hook log.
In VS Code, the hook log is the **GitHub Copilot Chat Hooks** output channel.

GitHub Copilot CLI does not show the report to you or to the agent.
To check a Copilot CLI setup, start a session in another agent on the same computer.
That session reports the Copilot CLI settings too, because Sentinel checks the settings of every supported agent it finds.

## Findings and how to clear them

### A program is missing

`Error: required tool uv is not installed or not in PATH.` means a hook cannot run.
The same message appears for `jq` and `perl`.
Install the program and start a new session.
The [prerequisites](../index.qmd#prerequisites) table says how.

`Warning: optional tool gitleaks is not installed` means Sentinel detects secrets with its own patterns, which cover fewer formats.
Install `gitleaks` to detect more formats, or leave the warning.

### Claude Code runs commands in a shell other than bash

`Warning: CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL is unset.` or a value other than a bash means Claude Code can run commands in a shell whose syntax Sentinel does not read.
Set `CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL` to the path of a bash, for example `/bin/bash`, in the environment Claude Code starts from.

### A setting turns Sentinel off

A finding of this form names the setting, the file that sets it, and what it does:

```text
Warning: Claude Code: `disableAllHooks` is true in ~/.claude/settings.json, which turns off every hook, Sentinel's included.
```

Change or remove the setting in the file the finding names, then start a new session.

| Agent                     | Setting                                                         | To clear it                                              |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| Claude Code               | `disableAllHooks` is `true`                                      | remove it, or set it to `false`                          |
| Claude Code               | `enabledPlugins` sets Sentinel to `false`                        | run `claude plugin enable sentinel@sentinel-hooks`       |
| Codex                     | `features.hooks` is `false`                                      | remove it, or set it to `true`                           |
| Codex                     | `features.plugins` is `false`                                    | remove it, or set it to `true`                           |
| Codex                     | the `plugins` entry for Sentinel sets `enabled = false`          | set it to `true`                                         |
| Codex                     | a hook Sentinel registered is switched off                       | switch it on in `/hooks`                                 |
| GitHub Copilot CLI        | `disableAllHooks` is `true`                                      | remove it, or set it to `false`                          |
| GitHub Copilot CLI        | `enabledPlugins` sets Sentinel to `false`                        | run `copilot plugin enable sentinel`                     |
| GitHub Copilot in VS Code | `chat.useHooks` is `false`                                       | remove it, or set it to `true`                           |
| GitHub Copilot in VS Code | `chat.plugins.enabled` is `false`                                | remove it, or set it to `true`                           |
| GitHub Copilot in VS Code | `chat.plugins.enabledPlugins` sets Sentinel to `false`           | enable Sentinel in the Agent Customizations editor       |
| Pi                        | the `packages` entry for Sentinel leaves its extension unloaded | run `pi config` and enable the extension                 |

A finding about a managed settings file names a setting your organization controls.
Ask your administrator to change it.

### A model can answer Sentinel's questions

```text
Warning: Copilot CLI: `defaultPermissionMode` is unset, and Copilot CLI can then choose a value that lets a model answer a question a hook put to the user.
```

In assisted mode, a model answers Copilot CLI's permission prompts, including the questions Sentinel asks you.
The same finding appears when `defaultPermissionMode` is `"assisted"`.
To clear it, set `defaultPermissionMode` to `"manual"` in `~/.copilot/settings.json`.

### Sentinel cannot read a settings file

```text
Warning: Codex: ~/.codex/config.toml could not be read as toml, so its settings are unchecked.
```

Sentinel did not check the settings in that file.
Correct the file's syntax.

### Sentinel's own files are damaged

A finding that names a file inside the Sentinel install means that file is missing or damaged.
Install Sentinel again.

- `Error: guarded-paths.toml could not be loaded`: until you repair it, Sentinel asks you before each action that changes a file, or refuses the action where the agent cannot ask.
- `Warning: configuration-floor.toml could not be read`: Sentinel checked none of your agent settings.
